short_description:
GTA 6's Tommy Vercetti easter egg: a 12-switch puzzle that starts at the Badger radio tower in Key Lento and ends at the Turtle Head power station east of Hamlet, between 7 PM and 6 AM. The reward: Tommy Vercetti's shirt and bike. Fast travel or switching characters resets it. No story spoilers. Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides → GTA 6 Map).

Map: Rockstar Games' official Leonida map. Sources: GameSpot, Dexerto, PCGamesN, TheGamer, The Click.
